versions.changelog:
FeiFei Companion v4.0 is a major upgrade introducing an AI-powered trinity learning companion system focused on personalized, holistic student support.

- Implements Trinity Architecture: three specialized AI tutors (FeiFei, XiaoFei, Haoyun) collaborating for full academic and emotional support.
- Adds dynamic module selection, automatically assigning subject, family, or full-function support based on user input.
- Integrates UCL Empathic Learning and HERMES Dynamic Learning Loop methodologies across all components.
- Supports bilingual (Chinese/English) interaction and K12 subject coverage.
- Enhances family engagement with a new parent-child translator module and unified learning data sharing.
